meta.description: Cross-border Trade Business Process and Rules

data.scenario: Customer requests a no-reason return for cross-border goods
data.condition: The goods have completed customs clearance and the request is not related to quality issues
data.result: According to cross-border trade policies, returns without reason are not supported for cleared items

data.scenario: Customer reports quality defects in cross-border products
data.condition: The product has functional failure and the claim is filed within 7 calendar days of receipt
data.result: Full refund or exchange is supported, and the seller bears all international shipping costs

data.scenario: Customer requests return with unsealed product packaging
data.condition: The return is for non-quality reasons and the original manufacturer's seal has been broken
data.result: Secondary sales are affected; the system will reject the return request. Please keep original packaging

data.scenario: Return for goods damaged during cross-border logistics
data.condition: Packaging is obviously damaged upon receipt with a damage certificate from the logistics company
data.result: A fast-track refund channel will be opened, and losses will be covered by insurance and logistics providers

data.scenario: Customer rejection request due to customs clearance delay
data.condition: The delay caused by customs inspection does not exceed 15 business days
data.result: This is not considered a seller breach; free return requests due to such delays are not supported

data.scenario: Return request for fresh or perishable cross-border goods
data.condition: The product belongs to the perishable food category and has entered international transit
data.result: Such items do not support mid-transit interception or any form of return once shipped

data.scenario: Customer requests exchange due to subjective personal reasons
data.condition: Goods are intact and unsealed but the customer wants a different color, size, or specification
data.result: The customer must bear customs duties, logistics fees, and handling charges for both return and reshipping

data.scenario: Duty liability for goods sent back during return process
data.condition: Non-quality related cross-border return caused by the customer's personal reasons
data.result: Import duties incurred for return must be prepaid by the buyer or deducted from the refund

data.scenario: Return process due to incorrect item shipment by seller
data.condition: Received goods do not match the specifications or models in the detailed order description
data.result: Automatic system approval; the seller will compensate shipping costs after the buyer returns the item

data.scenario: Calculation standard for refund amounts with promotions
data.condition: The order includes coupons or promotional discounts and only partial items are returned
data.result: The refund is calculated based on the actual paid proportion after deducting promotional amounts

data.scenario: Return request for customized trade products
data.condition: Goods were specially customized to buyer specs with no obvious manufacturing quality issues
data.result: Customized goods do not support any form of return; the buyer must fulfill the final payment

data.scenario: Compensation claim for lost cross-border packages
data.condition: Logistics tracking shows no updates for 30 days and the carrier confirms the loss in transit
data.result: The system determines it as a lost parcel and triggers a full refund and carrier claim

data.scenario: Status inspection rules for returned commodities
data.condition: Returned goods arrive at the warehouse with signs of human use or visible stains
data.result: The seller has the right to refuse the refund and return the item to the buyer's original address

data.scenario: Return policy during promotional activities
data.condition: Goods were purchased during 'Buy One Get One' or bundle sales and a return is requested
data.result: The buyer must return both the main item and the gift, otherwise the gift's market value is deducted

data.scenario: Validity period limitation for return applications
data.condition: The buyer has not initiated any after-sales claim for more than 30 days after confirming receipt
data.result: The after-sales channel will close automatically, and no further return requests will be accepted

data.scenario: Return inspection for high-value electronic products
data.condition: Electronic products exceeding $1000 in unit price are returned for quality issues
data.result: Official after-sales appraisal and a testing report must be provided to start the return process

data.scenario: Situations where customs clearance taxes cannot be refunded
data.condition: Goods are returned because the buyer refused to cooperate in providing clearance documents
data.result: The buyer is responsible for round-trip shipping fees and non-refundable paid customs duties

data.scenario: Return settlement for cross-border distribution channels
data.condition: Downstream distributor initiates a return request after the settlement period has passed
data.result: The commission must be deducted in the next billing cycle before processing the refund difference

data.scenario: Return process for bonded warehouse shipments
data.condition: Goods shipped from a bonded warehouse are returned by the buyer in unsealed condition
data.result: Goods must return to the designated bonded warehouse; refund is processed after tax cancellation

data.scenario: Sampling return rules for bulk trade orders
data.condition: Defective items in a large batch purchase are found to exceed the 5% threshold
data.result: Partial refund for that batch or free replenishment for the defective part is supported

data.scenario: Restrictions on refund payment paths
data.condition: All refund requests are approved and funds are ready for disbursement
data.result: Refunds must return to the original payment account; changing to a third-party account is not allowed

data.scenario: Refund initiated due to false logistics tracking
data.condition: The tracking number provided by the seller shows no collection record within 7 business days
data.result: The buyer has the right to declare false shipment and the system will issue a full refund

data.scenario: Requirement for additional accessories during return
data.condition: The product being returned includes manuals, cables, warranty cards, or other accessories
data.result: Missing accessories will result in a cost deduction; please ensure all items are returned intact

data.scenario: Rejection rules for overseas direct mail goods
data.condition: The buyer refuses to sign for an overseas direct mail package without any legitimate justification
data.result: Buyer must compensate for shipping and clearance fees, deducted directly from the refund

data.scenario: Risk warning for returns of sensitive goods
data.condition: Goods containing built-in batteries, liquids, or powders are requested for return
data.result: Due to aviation regulations, items cannot be returned; local destruction or compensation is advised

data.scenario: Refund restriction rules for pre-sale orders
data.condition: Buyer pays a deposit for a pre-sale and wants a refund before the official shipping date
data.result: Deposits serve as a contract guarantee; they are non-refundable unless the seller breaches contract

data.scenario: Return application due to customs duty adjustments
data.condition: Buyer requests a return because cost increased due to a temporary tax hike in the destination country
data.result: Duty changes are market risks; this is not supported as a valid reason for a free return

data.scenario: Liability for damage during return transit
data.condition: Goods are damaged during the return trip due to improper packaging by the buyer
data.result: The buyer bears transit risk; the seller may refuse the refund upon receipt of damaged goods

data.scenario: Handling of returns due to long-term failure to pick up
data.condition: Package stays at the pickup point over 15 days and is forced back to the overseas warehouse
data.result: Considered an abandonment of goods; secondary shipping costs will be deducted from the refund

data.scenario: Return interruption due to force majeure events
data.condition: War, natural disasters, or strikes prevent the return package from being sent across borders
data.result: The return deadline will be extended, or an alternative compensation plan will be negotiated

data.scenario: Payment method selection for large trade orders
data.condition: Single contract order exceeds $100,000 and it is the first cooperation between parties
data.result: The use of an Irrevocable Sight Letter of Credit (L/C) is mandatory for settlement

data.scenario: Staged payment ratio setting rules
data.condition: Procurement of customized production equipment with a production cycle exceeding 3 months
data.result: Adopt a payment model of 30% advance + 40% progress payment + 30% final balance

data.scenario: Risk avoidance for payment exchange rate fluctuations
data.condition: Contract agreed in USD but the exchange rate fluctuates by more than 3%
data.result: A compensation mechanism is triggered to split the excess exchange loss between buyer and seller

data.scenario: Liability rules for bank intermediary fees
data.condition: International wire transfer via SWIFT without specified fee-bearing terms in the contract
data.result: Default to SHA mode (shared costs); intermediary bank fees are borne by the remitter

data.scenario: Calculation rules for overdue payment penalties
data.condition: Buyer fails to complete payment within 5 business days after the contract due date
data.result: A daily penalty of 0.05% of the overdue amount is charged until the funds are received

data.scenario: Conditions for converting security deposit into payment
data.condition: Buyer has paid a performance bond and all goods have passed arrival inspection
data.result: Buyer may apply to convert the bond directly into the payment for the final batch of goods

data.scenario: Limit warnings for third-party payment platforms
data.condition: Using PayPal or Stripe to pay for a single order exceeding $5,000
data.result: System will pause payment and require secondary real-name and transaction background verification

data.scenario: Scope restrictions for Cash on Delivery (COD)
data.condition: Shipping address is in a high-risk area or the product unit price exceeds $500
data.result: COD is not supported; full prepayment must be completed before shipment is arranged

data.scenario: Access rules for local currency settlement
data.condition: SE Asian buyers apply to settle in local currency like THB or MYR
data.result: Converted based on real-time rates with an additional 1% currency hedging surcharge

data.scenario: Handling of discrepancies in Letter of Credit (L/C)
data.condition: Bank audit finds minor discrepancies between Bill of Lading and L/C requirements
data.result: Seller must modify documents within 3 business days, or the buyer may refuse acceptance

data.scenario: Administrative restrictions on returning prepayments
data.condition: Buyer cancels order after paying deposit and requests a return of funds
data.result: Deduct seller's raw material costs plus a 5% administrative fee for breach of contract

data.scenario: Credit term benefits for long-term partners
data.condition: Continuous cooperation for 2+ years with annual order volume reaching $500,000
data.result: Eligible to apply for OA 30 days (payment 30 days after arrival) settlement mode

data.scenario: Authenticity verification of payment vouchers
data.condition: Buyer sends a bank slip image via email demanding immediate shipment arrangement
data.result: Shipment only starts after finance confirms the actual arrival of funds in the corporate account

data.scenario: Payment prerequisites for credit insurance coverage
data.condition: The order is insured by export credit insurance (e.g., SINOSURE)
data.result: Buyer must pay through designated bank accounts, otherwise insurance claims might be invalid

data.scenario: Monitoring of multiple abnormal small payments
data.condition: A single customer makes over 5 split payments for the same order within 24 hours
data.result: Suspected money laundering risk; system will freeze the account for manual audit

data.scenario: Handling fee distribution rules during refunds
data.condition: Refund request for a payment error caused by the buyer's misoperation
data.result: Bank wire transfer fees for the refund will be deducted from the original principal amount

data.scenario: Policy restrictions on cryptocurrency payments
data.condition: Buyer asks if payment in Bitcoin or USDT is supported for the goods
data.result: According to financial regulations, the company strictly prohibits accepting any cryptocurrency

data.scenario: Discounting of Usance Letters of Credit
data.condition: Seller needs to discount a 90-day Usance L/C due to liquidity constraints
data.result: The resulting discounting interest is borne by the seller and not added to the total price

data.scenario: Security verification requirements for payment environment
data.condition: Payment attempt detected from a non-compliant IP address or high-risk network
data.result: 3D Secure verification is triggered via SMS or email for secondary confirmation

data.scenario: Internal payment rules for related-party transactions
data.condition: Payment settlements between the head office and overseas subsidiaries
data.result: Implement quarterly Netting to reduce cross-border transaction and handling fees

data.scenario: Highest alert for changes in payment accounts
data.condition: Seller sends bank change notification via non-official channels like IM apps
data.result: Buyer must verify via phone and email; payment to new accounts is strictly forbidden without it

data.scenario: Payment conversion for multi-currency credit cards
data.condition: Buyer uses a non-USD credit card to pay on a USD-priced checkout page
data.result: The rate is determined by the issuing bank; buyer bears all foreign exchange conversion fees

data.scenario: Special channel for small sample order payments
data.condition: Sample orders or small test batches with a unit price below $100
data.result: Recommend using Western Union or rapid credit card payment for faster processing

data.scenario: Ownership transfer rules under installment payments
data.condition: Contract stipulates four installments and goods have been delivered to buyer's warehouse
data.result: Ownership remains with the seller until the final installment is paid in full

data.scenario: Payment delays due to anti-money laundering checks
data.condition: Bank conducts routine compliance background checks on specific remitters
data.result: Both parties must provide contract proof; delays during this period are not breaches

data.scenario: Triggering third-party collection for overdue accounts
data.condition: Buyer owes payment for over 90 days with no effective response to communication
data.result: The system will automatically transfer the debt to a third-party international collection agency

data.scenario: Tax withholding rules during payment
data.condition: Local laws require the buyer to withhold income tax (WHT) on service fees
data.result: Buyer must provide official tax certificates so the seller can offset accounts in finance

data.scenario: Validity period for prepaid貨款
data.condition: Buyer prepays but fails to instruct shipping for over 12 months and is unreachable
data.result: Funds are moved to a suspense account; reactivation requires proof of identity

data.scenario: Issuance requirements for Standby L/C (SBLC)
data.condition: Used as payment guarantee for long-term contracts, covering two months of value
data.result: The issuing bank must be among the top 100 globally or a company-approved first-class bank

data.scenario: Dynamic adjustment of customer credit score in payment system
data.condition: Buyer has a serious L/C dishonor or unprovoked payment delinquency incident
data.result: System reduces credit rating to lowest; all credit terms are permanently revoked

data.scenario: HS Code classification for imported goods
data.condition: Complex product attributes lead to unclear HS codes or declaration disputes
data.result: Must apply for an advance ruling from customs before formal declaration to ensure compliance

data.scenario: Applying for preferential tariffs under Free Trade Agreements
data.condition: Origin belongs to a member state and the value exceeds the specified limit
data.result: Must submit a formal Certificate of Origin (CO) issued by authorized bodies in paper or digital form

data.scenario: Limit control for cross-border e-commerce retail imports
data.condition: Single transaction exceeds 5,000 RMB or annual total exceeds 26,000 RMB
data.result: The order cannot be cleared under e-commerce tax; it must convert to general trade declaration

data.scenario: Cooperation requirements during customs inspections
data.condition: Goods are randomly selected by the system for physical inspection or chemical appraisal
data.result: Customs broker must be present within 24 hours with detailed technical specifications

data.scenario: Declaration of customs protection for Intellectual Property
data.condition: Exported goods use trademarks registered with the General Administration of Customs
data.result: Formal authorization from the right holder must be submitted, otherwise goods will be detained

data.scenario: Regulatory rules for temporary import and export goods
data.condition: Goods for exhibition or research must be re-exported in original state within 6 months
data.result: A full tax margin must be paid to customs and the verification procedure completed on time

data.scenario: Levying of Anti-dumping and Countervailing duties
data.condition: Imported products are on the anti-dumping list from specific countries of origin
data.result: In addition to normal duties, the system will automatically calculate and levy anti-dumping taxes

data.scenario: Restriction rules for used electromechanical products
data.condition: Products are on the national directory of prohibited used electromechanical imports
data.result: Customs will reject the declaration and order the enterprise to return the goods

data.scenario: Quarantine permit application for plant and animal products
data.condition: Importing agricultural products not on the prohibited entry list but requiring inspection
data.result: An 'Entry Animal and Plant Quarantine Permit' must be obtained before signing the contract

data.scenario: Declaration delay due to customs system failure
data.condition: General Administration of Customs system crash prevents electronic data submission
data.result: Contact port customs to start contingency plans for manual mode or offline processing

data.scenario: Classification rules for low-value express shipments
data.condition: Package value is below 50 RMB and does not involve license-controlled goods
data.result: Can be declared as Category C express for simplified processing and duty exemption

data.scenario: Verification rules for bonded nuclear injection lists
data.condition: Processing trade enterprise exports finished products and needs to verify raw materials
data.result: Must ensure the item numbers of finished goods match the filing list exactly for verification

data.scenario: Qualification check for hazardous goods declaration
data.condition: Exported goods are flammable or explosive chemicals in the restricted directory
data.result: Must provide a 'Result List of Inspection of Packaging for Outbound Goods' and hazardous filing

data.scenario: Application of Customs Self-disclosure policy
data.condition: Enterprise discovers tax underpayment in past declarations and reports in writing
data.result: Can be exempted from late fees and administrative liability upon customs recognition

data.scenario: Authenticity audit of进出口货物 declared prices
data.condition: Customs considers declared price significantly lower than international market average
data.result: Enterprise must provide price composition, invoices, and payment proof within 10 business days

data.scenario: Regulatory requirements for transit trade goods
data.condition: Goods transit through China to a third country without entering domestic circulation
data.result: Must enter/exit through designated ports and be monitored via GPS or customs seals

data.scenario: Usage restriction rules for ATA Carnets
data.condition: Professional equipment uses ATA Carnet for temporary import declaration
data.result: Equipment cannot be leased or sold locally and must be re-exported within the validity period

data.scenario: Reporting and tax payment for royalties
data.condition: Buyer pays royalties to the seller related to goods and as a condition of sale
data.result: Royalties must be included in the imported dutiable value for customs duty payment

data.scenario: Strict control over imported waste materials
data.condition: Declared goods belong to the 'foreign garbage' catalog prohibited by the state
data.result: Case will be handled by anti-smuggling departments; importer bears all return and destruction costs

data.scenario: Facilitation benefits for AEO Advanced Certified Enterprises
data.condition: Enterprise has obtained AEO Advanced Certification with a good credit record
data.result: Enjoys extremely low inspection rates, priority clearance, and mutual recognition benefits

data.scenario: Tax reduction rules for returned goods
data.condition: Goods returned due to quality issues are re-imported in original state within one year
data.result: Can apply for import duty exemption with original export documents and proof of return

data.scenario: Mandatory reporting time for import/export goods
data.condition: Imported goods are not declared to customs within 14 days of the carrier's arrival
data.result: Customs will levy a delayed declaration fee of 0.05% of the total value per day

data.scenario: Fumigation rules for wood packaging materials
data.condition: Imported packaging contains solid wood without the required IPPC mark
data.result: Customs will order mandatory fumigation or destruction at the importer's expense

data.scenario: Modification rules for export tax rebate declarations
data.condition: Input error leads to discrepancy between declared export amount and settlement amount
data.result: Must submit settlement slips and an explanation to port customs for data modification approval

data.scenario: Policy for domestic goods entering Bonded Logistics Parks
data.condition: Domestic goods enter the park for export distribution or international transit
data.result: Entry is deemed as export; enterprises can apply for tax rebates early with the entry bill

data.scenario: Regulatory rules for gifts and samples
data.condition: Free gifts shipped with bulk goods or commercial samples for market promotion
data.result: Must be declared at actual value even if no foreign exchange is received, marked as 'Gift/Sample'

data.scenario: Compliance access for imported medical devices
data.condition: Products fall under the scope of the Regulations on the Supervision of Medical Devices
data.result: A 'Medical Device Registration Certificate' must be provided for customs clearance

data.scenario: Transit supervision for multimodal transport goods
data.condition: Goods unloaded at a port and transferred via rail/road to inland customs for clearance
data.result: Must handle transit declaration; vehicles must have customs-supervised transport qualifications

data.scenario: Hygiene license audit for imported cosmetics
data.condition: First-time import of non-special or special purpose cosmetics
data.result: Must submit the filing certificate or approval number issued by the drug regulatory department

data.scenario: Import rules for Tariff-Rate Quota (TRQ) managed goods
data.condition: Importing agricultural products like wheat or corn managed by quotas
data.result: Must present a TRQ certificate for low rates; out-of-quota imports will face high tariffs

data.scenario: Identification and packaging of hazardous goods in transit
data.condition: Goods include lithium batteries, compressed gases, or flammable chemicals
data.result: Must use international standard hazardous packaging with clear classification labels

data.scenario: Distribution of international freight insurance obligations
data.condition: Trade contract is concluded under CIF (Cost, Insurance, and Freight) terms
data.result: Seller must arrange insurance and pay the premium, with coverage at 110% of the invoice value

data.scenario: Calculation rules for chargeable weight in air freight
data.condition: The volumetric weight (L×W×H/6000) of the goods exceeds their actual physical weight
data.result: Airlines will use volumetric weight as the billing basis, resulting in higher freight costs

data.scenario: Calculation of container demurrage in sea freight
data.condition: Container remains at the destination port beyond the free period (typically 7 days)
data.result: Consignee must pay daily demurrage fees ranging from $50 to $100 per container

data.scenario: Temperature monitoring rules for cold chain goods
data.condition: Carrying fresh food or vaccines with strict environmental temperature requirements
data.result: Must use temperature recorders and read data upon receipt as a basis for acceptance

data.scenario: Warehouse entry timing for Less than Container Load (LCL)
data.condition: Small shipments from multiple shippers delivered to the CFS before the cutoff date
data.result: Late delivery will result in failure to load the vessel and additional rescheduling fees

data.scenario: Real-time synchronization of cross-border logistics status
data.condition: Carrier system detects a change in package status like departure or arrival
data.result: Must sync logistics updates to the e-commerce platform via API within 2 hours for customers

data.scenario: Special transport arrangements for oversized/overweight goods
data.condition: Single item exceeds 12 meters in length or 30 tons in weight
data.result: Apply for flat rack containers or heavy-lift trucks 15 days early with a surcharge

data.scenario: Reinforcement and protection standards for logistics packaging
data.condition: Carrying fragile or high-value instruments over a distance exceeding 3,000 km
data.result: Must use wooden pallets and corner protectors, wrapped in at least five layers of film

data.scenario: Handling of picking errors in overseas warehouse processes
data.condition: Warehouse staff issues wrong items due to scanning errors or instruction mismatch
data.result: Warehouse provider bears all secondary shipping costs and pays delay compensation to the customer

data.scenario: Responsibility division for international multimodal transport
data.condition: Goods are damaged or affected by moisture during the transition from sea to rail transport
data.result: The multimodal transport operator compensates the cargo owner first, then seeks recourse from the carrier

data.scenario: Signature verification rules for last-mile express delivery
data.condition: Package value exceeds $200 or contains sensitive commercial contract documents
data.result: The recipient must show ID and provide a handwritten signature; delivery to pick-up points is prohibited

data.scenario: Requirement for accompanying clearance documents with cargo
data.condition: Goods are shipped to countries with strict customs regulations like Brazil or India
data.result: Original invoices, packing lists, and local tax ID numbers must be physically attached to the goods

data.scenario: Handling of cargo damage caused by force majeure during transit
data.condition: A cargo ship encounters an extreme typhoon on the high seas resulting in lost containers
data.result: General Average principles apply; losses are shared by the ship owner, cargo owners, and insurers

data.scenario: Service Level Agreement (SLA) assessment for carriers
data.condition: The quarterly on-time delivery rate of a logistics provider falls below the agreed 95%
data.result: The system automatically reduces order allocation and triggers a penalty deduction per the contract

data.scenario: Emergency plan for air-to-sea freight conversion
data.condition: Air fuel surcharges skyrocket, causing air freight costs to exceed the budget limit
data.result: Change to fast sea freight with buyer consent, and the seller refunds the freight price difference

data.scenario: Secondary delivery attempt for abnormal logistics packages
data.condition: First delivery fails due to an incorrect recipient address or the phone being unreachable
data.result: The logistics company must attempt at least two more free deliveries within 3 business days

data.scenario: Mandatory requirements for palletization of goods
data.condition: Goods are sent to Amazon FBA warehouses or large multinational distribution centers
data.result: Items must be on ISPM 15 compliant wooden pallets with a total height not exceeding 1.8 meters

data.scenario: Remote area surcharges in cross-border logistics
data.condition: The shipping address is in a mountain, island, or region without permanent express facilities
data.result: The buyer must pay an additional remote area surcharge during checkout to generate the waybill

data.scenario: Rules for international shipping marks on outer packaging
data.condition: Bulk trade goods enter the terminal yard for loading or transit through a port
data.result: Packaging must have clear marks including destination, box number, weight, and order ID

data.scenario: Lost parcel determination time in the logistics chain
data.condition: The package shows no dynamic update records for more than 20 consecutive calendar days
data.result: The sender can formally file a lost parcel claim and enter the insurance compensation process

data.scenario: Monthly billing vs. prepayment rules for logistics costs
data.condition: A long-term trade enterprise with a stable shipping volume exceeding 1,000 parcels per month
data.result: The enterprise can apply for monthly billing to ease liquidity pressure on operating funds

data.scenario: Selection and liability guarantee of logistics agents
data.condition: Appointing a non-owned freight forwarder for cross-border multimodal transport services
data.result: Must verify the forwarder's Class A qualification and their valid liability insurance policy

data.scenario: Port entry and loading timing for export goods
data.condition: Goods must enter the terminal before the shipping company's scheduled closing time
data.result: Failure to meet the deadline results in missing the vessel and extra storage or rescheduling fees

data.scenario: Supervision of international rail transport (China-Europe Railway Express)
data.condition: Goods are transported via rail through multiple transit countries across borders
data.result: Must meet CIM rail consignment note requirements and strictly prohibit magnetic materials

data.scenario: Extra storage fees incurred during the logistics process
data.condition: Goods are stranded in an overseas warehouse because the buyer failed to obtain a permit
data.result: After a 3-day free period, the buyer pays $5 per cubic meter per day for storage

data.scenario: Delivery rules for logistics documents like Bills of Lading
data.condition: The payment is settled and the seller has obtained the original Bill of Lading from the carrier
data.result: The seller must mail the original documents to the buyer via international express within 2 days

data.scenario: Feedback mechanism for logistics complaints and suggestions
data.condition: A customer files a formal complaint regarding staff attitude or transport delays
data.result: The customer service team must investigate within 12 hours and provide a solution within 48 hours

data.scenario: Diversion of transport due to war in cross-border shipping
data.condition: The original route passes through a country where war or armed conflict suddenly breaks out
data.result: The carrier may divert to ensure safety; additional costs are shared by the cargo owners

data.scenario: Rules for statistics of logistics carbon emission data
data.condition: An enterprise needs to track the full-link logistics carbon footprint for green compliance
data.result: The logistics provider must provide monthly standardized reports on mileage and CO2 emissions

data.scenario: Order limit for new customers without background checks
data.condition: A customer purchases in bulk for the first time without a deep credit investigation
data.result: The maximum limit for the first order is $10,000; any excess requires full prepayment

data.scenario: Warning for orders from high-risk countries and regions
data.condition: Shipping address or paying bank is in a region under sanctions or in political turmoil
data.result: The system automatically intercepts the order for manual compliance review by the risk team

data.scenario: Dynamic downgrade mechanism for customer credit ratings
data.condition: A customer has experienced more than two incidents of malicious payment delinquency in a quarter
data.result: The system drops their rating to Grade D, revokes credit terms, and requires cash on delivery

data.scenario: Fraud identification for large online credit card payments
data.condition: The same card number attempts multiple payments of varying amounts in a short period
data.result: The anti-fraud model is triggered; the system immediately freezes the card's payment function

data.scenario: Monitoring of abnormal benefit transfers in related transactions
data.condition: Transaction price deviates from fair market value and parties have an equity relationship
data.result: The transaction is flagged as abnormal; an independent audit report is required for explanation

data.scenario: Coverage rules for Export Credit Insurance (SINOSURE)
data.condition: The total outstanding balance for a single customer exceeds the bank-approved credit limit
data.result: The risk department stops further shipments until old accounts are settled to release the limit

data.scenario: Annual prudent verification rules for supplier qualifications
data.condition: A long-term supplier is found to have an expired or revoked business license during review
data.result: Stop signing any new contracts immediately and perform a risk liquidation on open orders

data.scenario: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring in cross-border remittances
data.condition: A large remittance is received and the payer name does not match the contract buyer
data.result: Finance suspends the funds; the buyer must provide a legal payment agreement and ID documents

data.scenario: Impairment risk warning for low inventory turnover rates
data.condition: Electronic goods in a bonded warehouse have been stored for more than 180 calendar days
data.result: Trigger the price-drop reserve process; sales must create a clearance plan within a time limit

data.scenario: Business continuity risk due to core management resignation
data.condition: The overseas sales director holding core client resources resigns without a formal handover
data.result: The risk team must contact affected clients within 24 hours to reconfirm contract intentions

data.scenario: Safety assessment of overseas branches during political unrest
data.condition: A branch location experiences serious social unrest or a sudden local policy change
data.result: Activate the Level 1 response; suspend local physical trading and prioritize staff evacuation

data.scenario: Usage rules for credit reports from third-party agencies
data.condition: Conducting background checks on strategic partners with contracts exceeding $500,000
data.result: Must purchase a comprehensive credit report from agencies like D&B as a decision reference

data.scenario: Transaction freezing rules due to pending legal litigation
data.condition: A partner is under judicial investigation for suspected major fraud or bankruptcy protection
data.result: Enter risk isolation mode; stop all fund transfers and delivery actions immediately

data.scenario: Preliminary filtering logic for fake business inquiries
data.condition: An inquiry email lacks a specific company name, phone number, or detailed product parameters
data.result: The system moves such info to a 'To Be Confirmed' pool; it is not counted as a formal lead

data.scenario: Prevention of leakage for high-value sensitive data
data.condition: An internal employee sends core price lists through an external email in an unauthorized environment
data.result: The DLP system automatically blocks the email and logs the violation for HR synchronization

data.scenario: Transaction authorization limits for currency hedging tools
data.condition: A finance staff member performs a single foreign exchange forward lock-in operation
data.result: Operations exceeding $2 million must be jointly approved by the CFO and the Board of Directors

data.scenario: Fraud identification rules for 'Drop-shipping' models
data.condition: Large volumes of different buyer accounts ship goods to the same overseas private residence
data.result: Determined as potential card fraud or brush behavior; the system cancels and refunds the orders

data.scenario: Supply chain disruption caused by major environmental accidents
data.condition: A core component manufacturer is ordered to stop production indefinitely for environmental violations
data.result: The risk department must activate backup suppliers within 3 days and adjust delivery expectations

data.scenario: Financial due diligence requirements in overseas M&A projects

data.scenario: Termination for convenience and compensation rules

data.scenario: Rules for setting a cap on liability for breach
